# dsh-quality-score

Quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins: 0-100 score + grade + per-component breakdown (manifest, peer resolvability, dist-tag health, dead ranges, freshness, dsh-tools peer compat) with issues and fix suggestions.

- Install into dsh: `dsh plugin add dsh-quality-score`
- CLI: `npx dsh-quality-score <npm-name> [--json]`
- Agent tool: `quality_score(name)` — returns dsh-quality-score/v1 reports
- Zero runtime dependencies, read-only, degrades gracefully offline
